name: e2e-08-every-request-task
description: E2E-08: two knowledge questions in two tasks (two sessions of one workgroup VM), then a follow-up in the first task that reaches the same Claude Code session (its conversation holds the earlier turn). Every task starts with a fresh context (KONZEPT idea 43): the first turn of each task is a conversation of exactly one user message that holds nothing of the other task (question and answer). Background requests without tools get a short title.

expect.user_text_contains: What is the capital of France?
